g.text: Joint map quality along paired routes
Two parent scenes with shelves and cabinets swapped between sides.
Markers show native-map measurements. Large archive gaps are left open. Shading marks Gallery actions 38–58.
Hollow symbols mark actual terminal states. All plotted runs returned with zero simulated collisions.
